AboutPage.heroTitle: AFAQ HEALTH, Partner in Healthcare Brand Development
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: From Europe to the Moroccan market, we build the conditions for sustainable establishment.
AboutPage.heroText1: AFAQ HEALTH is a Moroccan company specializing in the development, import, and marketing of European brands in the fields of nutrition, dietary supplements, and well-being.
AboutPage.heroText2: We assist European manufacturers and brands in their development on the Moroccan market, combining local market knowledge, regulatory compliance, commercial development, and professional networking.
AboutPage.heroHighlight: Our role is not limited to distributing products. We build their presence in the market.
AboutPage.missionSubtitle: Making quality European solutions accessible, with a demanding local approach.
AboutPage.missionText1: Our mission is to select and develop brands that meet high standards of quality, formulation, and compliance, and then create the necessary conditions for their sustainable development in the Moroccan market.
AboutPage.missionText2: We act as an interface between European manufacturers and the various players in the healthcare chain, ensuring the necessary coordination between the manufacturer's requirements, local market constraints, and the needs of professionals.
AboutPage.accompagnement3: Advice provided to consumers is the responsibility of healthcare professionals, as part of their practice.
AboutPage.missionClosing: Our ambition is to build lasting relationships, based on trust, rigor, and a long-term vision.
AboutPage.expertiseTitle: More than a distributor, a development partner.
AboutPage.expertiseText1: Accessing a new market is not just about importing a product.
AboutPage.expertiseText2: It requires understanding the regulatory environment, adapting positioning, preparing the launch, building distribution channels, and gradually developing a presence among healthcare professionals and consumers.
AboutPage.expertiseText3: This is exactly the role of AFAQ HEALTH.
AboutPage.expertiseSubtitle: An integrated approach across six areas of expertise
AboutPage.exp1Desc: Potential analysis, positioning, segmentation, and preparation for launch on the Moroccan market.
AboutPage.exp2Desc: Coordination of regulatory procedures, preparation and monitoring of product documentation, compliance of materials, and tracking applicable requirements.
AboutPage.exp3Desc: Organization of import operations and coordination with partners to ensure product availability on the market.
AboutPage.exp4Desc: Building and developing distribution channels, supporting the launch, and progressively developing product ranges.
AboutPage.exp5Desc: Providing product information and supporting pharmacists and healthcare professionals in their knowledge and use of our ranges.
AboutPage.exp6Desc: Positioning, marketing materials, communication, and actions aimed at progressively building a lasting presence in the market.
AboutPage.reseauTitle: Building bridges between brands and healthcare professionals
AboutPage.reseauSubtitle: The development of a health brand relies on the quality of its professional environment.
AboutPage.reseauText: AFAQ HEALTH works with complementary partners to create a coherent chain, from product availability to consumer access.
AboutPage.net1Desc: Partners selected for the quality of their products, their expertise, and their ability to support the development of their brands in new markets.
AboutPage.net2Desc: Partners ensuring commercial coverage and availability adapted to the market. The national distribution of AFAQ HEALTH products is managed by DAWA MAGHREB, an approved pharmaceutical establishment.
AboutPage.net3Desc: The pharmacy network is an essential point of contact for product availability and consumer access.
AboutPage.net4Desc: A close relationship allowing for a better presentation of product features and contributing to appropriate consumer information.
AboutPage.reseauClosing: Our goal: to build a coherent and lasting network around each brand, rather than a simple distribution chain.
AboutPage.eng1Desc: We favor brands and products that meet strict criteria for quality, formulation, and traceability.
AboutPage.eng2Desc: We pay close attention to the regulatory requirements applicable to each product before it is brought to market and throughout its development.
AboutPage.eng3Desc: We prioritize lasting relationships with our manufacturers, distributors, pharmacists, and healthcare professionals.
AboutPage.eng4Desc: We ensure our brands are developed with clear, responsible communication that is suited to the regulatory status of each product.
AboutPage.portefeuilleTitle: European brands selected for their potential
AboutPage.portefeuilleSubtitle: AFAQ HEALTH is progressively developing a portfolio of complementary brands in the fields of nutrition, dietary supplements, and well-being.
AboutPage.brand1Desc: A Spanish brand of dietary supplements developed around various categories of nutrition and well-being.
AboutPage.brand2Desc: A range dedicated to child nutrition and well-being.
AboutPage.brand3Desc: A range specializing in collagen-based solutions, particularly focusing on beauty and mobility.
AboutPage.ambitionTitle: Building sustainable brands in African markets.
AboutPage.ambitionText1: Morocco constitutes our development market and our anchor point.
AboutPage.ambitionText2: Ultimately, AFAQ HEALTH aims to support some of the brands in its portfolio into other French-speaking African markets, taking into account the specific regulatory, commercial, and professional conditions of each country.
AboutPage.ambitionText3: This ambition is based on a progressive approach: first consolidating brands on the Moroccan market, then building their regional development when the conditions are right.
AboutPage.ambitionHighlight: Our ambition is not to multiply product lines. It is to build a coherent portfolio of healthcare brands capable of making a lasting impact in their markets.
